content.title: Masters 2027 tickets: How to apply, when the lottery opens
content.text: Masters 2027 tickets: How to apply, when the lottery opensWant to attend the 2027 Masters Tournament? The application window for official 2027 Masters tickets is opening soon, giving golf fans a chance to purchase tickets directly from Augusta National.Practice round and daily tournament tickets for the Masters are distributed through a random selection process after fans submit an application. Commonly known as the Masters ticket lottery, this process is the only way to buy tickets directly from the Masters Tournament, the only authorized ticket seller.AdvertisementWhile Masters badges and daily tickets are often listed by third‑party resellers, often for thousands of dollars, those tickets are not sold or endorsed by the Masters. Fans who purchase tickets through unauthorized sellers risk having their tickets revoked and being denied entry.Fans hoping to attend the 2027 Masters Tournament can apply during the official application period, June 1-20, to enter the Masters ticket lottery for a chance to purchase tickets at face value.Here's what to know about the Masters 2027 ticket lottery:Masters 2027 datesThe 2027 Masters is scheduled for April 5-11.AdvertisementMonday-Wednesday, April 5-7, are practice rounds, with the Par 3 Contest on Wednesday.Thursday-Sunday, April 8-11, are tournament rounds.How to enter Masters ticket lottery 2027?Masters Tournament tickets for practice rounds Monday-Wednesday and single tournament days Thursday-Sunday are awarded by random selection after an application process.Those interested in 2027 Masters tickets can register an account now and be notified when the ticket application window opens June 1-20, 2026.How to get ANWA, Drive, Chip and Putt National Finals tickets?To increase your chances of being able to visit Augusta National Golf Club, you can also apply for 2027 Augusta National Women's Amateur and Drive, Chip and Putt National Finals tickets.AdvertisementThe women's amateur event's final round is played at Augusta National on Saturday before the Masters. For 2027, that date is April 3.The Drive, Chip and Putt event is held at Augusta National on Sunday before the Masters, though course access is restricted to clubhouse putting greens, No. 18 green area, No. 1 tee, No. 9 green and No. 10 tee. The 2027 Drive, Chip and Putt Finals are scheduled for April 4.All services, including concessions and merchandise shops, will be open to patrons.For 2026, practice round tickets for Monday and Tuesday were $125 and $150 for Wednesday (including the Par 3 Contest).AdvertisementDaily tournament tickets (Thursday-Sunday) were $160 each.Ticket prices for the 2027 Masters will be released when the ticket application window opens on June 1, 2026.How many tickets can I get if I win the Masters lottery?While you can apply for Masters tickets to any and all days, you can only win tickets for one day.As of 2026, up to four tickets could be requested during the application process.How will I know if I won the Masters ticket lottery?Once the random selection process is completed, those selected (and those not selected) will be notified via email.Can you sell your Masters tickets?Holders of tickets purchased from third parties are subject to exclusion from the Masters Tournament. The Masters is the only authorized ticket source.AdvertisementAnd anyone caught buying, selling or handing off tickets within a 2,700-foot boundary around Augusta National Golf Club could face criminal charges.Georgia's scalping law prohibits the sale of tickets within 2,700 feet of large sporting events."For all venues which seat or admit 15,000 or more persons, a ticket broker and its employees, agents, and assigns are criminally prohibited from reselling or offering for resale any ticket within 2,700 feet from the venue where an event or contest is to be held or is being held."Kim Luciani is a journalist for the USA TODAY Network-Florida's Audience team.
